The remaining failures are just my checker's Edges parsing (the split on ">>,<<" leaves the last element without ">>" and the first without "<<"). Let me fix the checker properly: strip the outer braces, then split on ">>,<<" and re-add the delimiters.

Let me rewrite that part cleanly.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src = open('checkexport.py').read()
old = """    got_edges = set(x.strip() for x in ebody.split(">>,<<")) if ebody else set()
    if got_edges:
        got_edges = set(("<<" + x[2:] if not x.startswith("<<") else x) for x in got_edges)"""
new = """    got_edges = set()
    if ebody:
        parts = ebody.split(",")
        # regroup into triples of numbers
        nums = [p.strip() for p in parts]
        triples = []
        i = 0
        while i < len(nums):
            if nums[i].startswith("<<"):
                cur = nums[i][2:]
                i += 1
                while not cur.endswith(">>"):
                    cur += "," + nums[i]
                    i += 1
                cur = cur[:-2]
            else:
                cur = nums[i]
                i += 1
                while not cur.endswith(">>"):
                    cur += "," + nums[i]
                    i += 1
                cur = cur[:-2]
            triples.append("<<%s>>" % cur)
        got_edges = set(triples)"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('checkexport.py','w').write(src)
print("ok")
PYEOF
